title: Proofline Human Approval Record
description: One record per gate decision. Append-only: never edit a signed record; supersede it with a new one.

subject.description: What exactly is being approved (dependency@version, asset id, page, vendor, quote)

approver.description: Human name. Never a tool or an agent.

evidence.description: URLs, file paths, command outputs, screenshots that justify the decision

expires_on.description: e.g. licence reviews expire after 90 days
